Parse CEF extension key-value pairs (rt, src, shost, suser, duser, act, cat, dst, dhost, fname, fsize, cs1/cs1Label, cs2/cs2Label, outcome, reason)

conf.regex: /^rt=(?<timestamp>.*?) src=(?<src_ip>\S+)(?: shost=(?<src_host>\S+))?(?: suser=(?<user>\S+))?(?: duser=(?<dst_user>\S+))?(?: act=(?<action>\S+))?(?: cat=(?<category>.*?))?(?: dst=(?<dst_ip>\S+))?(?: dhost=(?<dst_host>\S+))?(?: fname=(?<filename>.*?))?(?: fsize=(?<file_size>\d+))?(?: cs1=(?<cs1>.*?))?(?: cs1Label=(?<cs1_label>\S+))?(?: cs2=(?<cs2>.*?))?(?: cs2Label=(?<cs2_label>\S+))?(?: outcome=(?<outcome>\S+))?(?: reason=(?<reason>.*))?$/
